description: This file implements a GStreamer plugin element called RialtoWebAudioSink, which acts as a sink for Web Audio data in the Rialto framework. It manages state transitions, handles GStreamer events, and communicates with Rialto server components to control Web Audio playback.

classes.name: RialtoWebAudioSink
classes.description: A GStreamer element acting as a Web Audio sink for Rialto, handling state changes, events, and communication with Rialto server components.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_async_start
methods.description: Starts an asynchronous state transition in the Web Audio sink.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_async_done
methods.description: Marks the completion of an asynchronous state transition.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_sink_eos_handler
methods.description: Handles End-Of-Stream (EOS) event, posting appropriate GStreamer messages based on current state.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_sink_error_handler
methods.description: Posts an error message to GStreamer pipeline.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_sink_rialto_state_changed_handler
methods.description: Handles state change notifications from Rialto server, managing GStreamer state transitions accordingly.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_sink_setup_supported_caps
methods.description: Sets up supported capabilities (caps) for the sink element.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_sink_send_event
methods.description: Handles GStreamer events sent to the sink pad, such as EOS and CAPS.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_sink_change_state
methods.description: Manages GStreamer state changes, coordinating with WebAudioClient and Rialto control client.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_sink_event
methods.description: Handles GStreamer events on the sink pad, such as opening WebAudio with caps or EOS.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_sink_get_property
methods.description: Retrieves properties of the WebAudio sink, currently only logs unsupported properties.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_sink_set_property
methods.description: Sets properties of the WebAudio sink, currently only logs unsupported properties.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_sink_chain
methods.description: Processes incoming buffers, notifying WebAudioClient of new samples.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_sink_initialise_sinkpad
methods.description: Initializes the sink pad with event and chain functions.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_sink_init
methods.description: Initializes the RialtoWebAudioSink object, setting up clients and sink pad.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_sink_finalize
methods.description: Finalizes and cleans up the WebAudioSink object.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_sink_class_init
methods.description: Class initialization for the WebAudioSink, setting up metadata, properties, and function pointers.
